scope.corpus: 100 archived samples from the completed whl endpoint review
scope.perspective: Security engineer discovering the file on an endpoint
scope.purgatory: Quarantined with unresolved authorization, payload, or provenance questions

changes.subject: upload_file helper naming
changes.repair: Moved the call-name and function-name observations from filesystem behavior to metadata/lang/source/naming/action/function-name. All exact consumers were updated. Removed the generic helper-name branch from the HTTP upload API composite.
changes.precision: An actual function_definition is required; quoted examples, comments, suffix names and class declarations do not qualify. Calling a helper named upload_file alone does not establish HTTP transfer.

changes.subject: Eager Python Thread targets
changes.repair: Structural queries distinguish target=collect() from a callable or lambda target. The module-level class profile requires an expression directly in the suite of a class directly in the module.
changes.coverage: Accepts superclass lists, keyword arguments and multiline constructor formatting; excludes methods, nested classes inside functions and quoted examples. The target call evaluates synchronously before thread construction.

changes.subject: CI identifier upload profile
changes.repair: Requires upload and module-level class observations in the same source leaf rather than pooling archive members. Description explicitly reports co-occurrence.
changes.limit: Does not prove the eager target invokes the upload function or that authentication/network access succeeds.

changes.subject: Platform-guarded call description
changes.repair: Reports a platform-guarded module-level call without asserting the guard succeeds or that the call executes on every import.

changes.subject: Windows CNG decryption
changes.repair: Moved generic NCryptDecrypt from the browser-theft objective to crypto/provider/cryptoapi. Requires a call rather than a mere symbol reference. Browser intent remains in the existing app-bound-key composite.
changes.result: The original auto.py retains both hostile findings, including app-bound-key theft.

verification.hostile_before_after: Identical hostile finding sets on all 26 paired scan targets; additional class-name control has zero hostile findings.

validation.scope: Prior fully validated frozen tree plus current modified files and the concurrent Chromium SQL refactor. This does not claim validation of unrelated live workspace edits.
